ae_item_base_info_dto.subject: 10 Degree Golf Tees Upgrade 5 Levels Adjustable Height Unbreakable Bendable Golf Tees Stable Insert Anti-Fly Consistent Swing
ae_item_base_info_dto.detail: Upgraded from the popular 10° golf tees, our golf tees feature a 10-degree optimized angle for longer, straighter shots. Made of super tough bendable material, it’s unbreakable even when bent hard. Added stable insert piece for better grip in soil, reduces tee pop-out and flying away. 5 adjustable height levels let you lock the same height every time, ensuring consistent swing and ball contact. Low friction design improves distance and accuracy. Perfect golf accessories for practice and training.
